harm_if_wrong: Baselines that hold the wrong tables and rows per page (a stop that misses the reads it should guard, or a feature map that exempts real leaks), so later steps cut against false numbers; production is untouched.
make_it_cheaper: Write each stop's calls (function and arguments, per page file) and the FEATURE_TABLES map into the brief, name the dispatcher jobs safe to run idle, and give the signatures of the step 1.9/1.10 helpers it uses; commit 2 would then be cheap-then-review.
